sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_date AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS trade_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows)
SELECT 
    f.trade_date,
    f.flow_signal,
    f.fii_trend,
    f.dii_trend,
    r.regime,
    r.confidence,
    r.days_in_regime,
    b.ad_signal,
    b.trin,
    b.market_sentiment,
    i.index_symbol,
    i.change_pct
FROM 
    signals.fii_dii_flows f
JOIN
    signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN
    breadth.market_daily b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN
    market.index_eod i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
WHERE 
    f.trade_date = (SELECT trade_date FROM latest_date)
AND 
    i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
LIMIT 5;

validation_rules: rules
